EVIDENCE CARD — Harbor-m3v1 export requests cut off at the edge while the upstream finished

## Observed environment
Project: /workspace/projects/harbor
Edge proxy in front of reports-api, 2026-08-26

## The configuration (task text, quoted in full)
deploy/edge/reports.conf, location /api/reports/export, sets two directives:
  proxy_pass       http://reports_api;
  proxy_read_timeout 30s;
The upstream block names one server, reports-api:8080.
Source: PRIOR_SOURCE_PACKET.md, conf file; PRIOR_TASK.md, description.

## The failure the edge logged (EXECUTED)
Two requests logged: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, for tenants acme-holdings and brightline.
Source: PRIOR_SOURCE_PACKET.md, edge error log.

## What the client got (EXECUTED)
Both requests returned 504 at request_time 30 in the edge access log.
Source: PRIOR_SOURCE_PACKET.md, edge access log.
proxy_read_timeout is the gap allowed between two successive read operations, not a budget for the whole response.

## What the upstream did (EXECUTED)
The upstream access log shows both requests completing with 200, at upstream_response_time 41 and 44. The work was finished; the edge was no longer reading.
Source: PRIOR_SOURCE_PACKET.md, upstream access log.

## The tenants that succeeded (EXECUTED)
The next eight tenants by row count all returned 200, between upstream_response_time 4 and 9.
Source: PRIOR_SOURCE_PACKET.md, upstream access log.

## Size of the two failing tenants (EXECUTED)
Row counts in the reports source table: acme-holdings 8241900 and brightline 8003117, against 1442083 for the next tenant down.
Source: PRIOR_SOURCE_PACKET.md, row counts.

## Limits and unknowns
- No proxy version appears in either artifact.
- The evidence shows this location setting the directive; it does not show what the value would be if the directive were absent.
- Nothing here establishes what the directive measures. A whole-response budget and a per-read gap are both consistent with what was observed.
- The status code is observed, not defined: no specification appears in the supplied evidence.
